name: Sizzle: AI Video, Photo & Voice
author: Sizzle

sections.description:
One plugin covers posts and products. Every account gets 50 free credits a month; after that you buy one-off credit packs that never renew, or pick a monthly plan if you prefer. Every action shows its price before it runs and your balance after it. Prices come from Sizzle each time; the current list is at https://sizzle.tools/pricing.

Sizzle Studio (Sizzle > Studio)

Every tool in one place, for any file in your Media Library. Pick a file with the usual media window; results are saved next to it.

  • Video from a description or from a photo: Fast, Studio or Pro, 5 or 10 seconds. The price is the same either way.
  • Photo: an image from text, clean-up (background removed, white or transparent, 4× sharper), a new scene or a new colour.
  • Upscale a video up to 10 seconds, 2× or 4×. A Fast video plus 2× is ready for Instagram Reels.
  • Music: pick a mood and a length, get three takes. Insert a take into any post.
  • Voice: paste any text, or start from a post, and pick the language. Studio reads many languages; Fast fewer, each with its own voices.
  • Try-on: a garment photo on a model photo.
  • In the Media Library: Remove background, New scene, Make a video and Upscale open Studio with the file already picked.

Sizzle Voice (WordPress)

  • Open a post, pick Fast or Studio and press Read aloud.
  • The MP3 is saved to your Media Library.
  • A small player appears above the post. Turn it off for any post, or for all of them.
  • Optional: read every new post aloud when it is published.
  • Pick the language and, on Fast, the voice. Fast reads fewer languages, each with voices of its own; Studio sounds more natural and reads many more. Both are priced by the length of the text.

Sizzle Video (WooCommerce)

  • A Sizzle panel on every product: pick a photo, Fast or Studio, 5 or 10 seconds.
  • The MP4 is saved to your Media Library and added to the product gallery.
  • WooCommerce 11.1 and later can show videos in the gallery once you switch on Product gallery videos under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Features. Until then, or on older WooCommerce, the video shows above the product description.
  • Fast is vertical and silent; Studio is landscape with its own sound. The price shows on the button before you start.

Try it on (WooCommerce)

  • A Try it on button under Add to cart: shoppers add a photo of themselves (or take one on a phone) and see the product on it, marked as an AI-generated preview.
  • Off until you switch it on in Sizzle > Settings, for every product or for the products you switch on in their Sizzle Try-on box.
  • Each try-on uses credits from your wallet; Sizzle > Settings shows how many. A daily cap for the store (50 by default) and 5 tries an hour for each visitor keep a busy page from draining it. With too few credits the button hides.
  • The photo goes to Sizzle only to make the preview and is deleted within 24 hours. Nothing is saved on your site; Activity lists each try-on without the photo.

Sizzle Photo (WooCommerce)

  • On a product: a new scene or a new colour for one of its photos. The new photo joins the product gallery; the original stays.
  • In Products, select products and pick Clean up photos (Sizzle) under Bulk actions.
  • Without WooCommerce, or for any photos: in Media > Library (list view) pick Clean up with Sizzle under Bulk actions, or use Choose photos on Sizzle > Photos. Up to 500 photos at a time; the cleaned photos are new files and the originals stay. The Sizzle results filter above the list shows every file Sizzle made.
  • White or transparent background, 4× sharper. The price per photo and the total show before anything runs.
  • The cleaned photos are saved next to the originals. A product only changes when you press Replace, and Restore puts the original back.

Long jobs run in the background (Action Scheduler with WooCommerce, WP-Cron without it), so pages never wait for them.

External services

This plugin connects to the Sizzle API (https://api.sizzle.tools), run by Sizzle, to price and make audio, video and photos. Nothing is sent until you connect an account and start an action (or switch on “Read new posts aloud when they are published”).

  • When you press Connect to Sizzle: the site address, the site name and the platform (WordPress or WooCommerce), shown on the Sizzle page where you approve the site; Sizzle sends back the site’s API key.
  • When you paste a key instead: your API key, to check it and show your balance.
  • When you read a post aloud: the post title and its text.
  • When you make a video, edit a photo or upscale a video: the file you picked (uploaded as a file, or, for a result Sizzle made in the last two hours, a reference to it).
  • When you make an image or a video from text, music or a voice-over in Studio: your description, the lyrics or the text, and the settings you chose.
  • When you make a try-on: the model photo and the garment photo you picked (uploaded as files).
  • When a shopper uses Try it on (only after you switch it on): the photo the shopper adds and the product’s main photo (uploaded as files). The preview the shopper sees loads from Sizzle.
  • When you buy credits: the chosen pack or plan and a return address in your WordPress admin. Payment happens on a secure Stripe Checkout page.

Results are downloaded into your own Media Library. Terms: https://sizzle.tools/terms. Privacy policy: https://sizzle.tools/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Sizzle > Account, press Connect to Sizzle and approve the site in your Sizzle account (or paste an API key).
  3. Open Sizzle > Studio, a post for Sizzle Voice, or a product for Sizzle Video and Sizzle Photo. For many photos at once, use the bulk action in Products.

To keep the key out of the database, add define( 'SIZZLE_API_KEY', 'sz_live_...' ); to wp-config.php.
sections.faq:
How much does it cost?

You pay in credits, from one-off packs or a monthly plan, and every action shows its price before it runs. The current prices are at https://sizzle.tools/pricing.

Is there a free option?

Yes. Every account gets 50 free credits a month. They do not carry over.

Where do the files go?

Into your own Media Library. Removing a result from a post or product keeps the file.

Does it work with my theme?

The player and the description video are added above the content, so they work with classic and block themes.

What if a job fails?

The credits go back to your wallet automatically.

Which languages does the plugin speak?

English, and Polish when your site or profile language is Polish.
sections.changelog:
0.2.0

  • Prices come from Sizzle each time and are no longer built into the plugin, so a price change needs no update. Bulk clean-up shows the price of the moment.
  • Sizzle Studio: video from a description or any photo (Fast, Studio, Pro), image from text, photo clean-up, new scene, colour change, video upscale, music, voice in every language Sizzle reads, and try-on, each with its price before it runs.
  • Media Library buttons that open Studio with the file picked.
  • WooCommerce: new scene and colour change for product photos, added to the gallery. Vertical gallery videos keep the shape of the product photos.

0.1.0

  • First version: Sizzle Voice for posts, Sizzle Video and bulk photo clean-up for WooCommerce, account screen with balance and credit packs.
